bsa_provenance: Model authors used an external mean BSA; original PK study did not report BSA. Not a measured participant or personalized input.
equation_4_status: The printed right side simplifies to -(k1-k1ss), but a rate factor is needed for dimensional consistency. The implementation explicitly assumes lambda=1 per hour. Author implementation and intended time scale are unverified.
clock_assumption: Elapsed hours from first dose; elimination clock is continuous and is not reset at later doses.
initial_conditions: All drug amounts and eliminated amount zero immediately before the first bolus.
scope: Three mathematical distribution compartments; not anatomical organs or PBPK. Instantaneous Equation 5 coupling only; no dynamic target binding state.
limitations: Rounded published parameters; parameter covariance unavailable and uncertainty not propagated.
